evals.prompt: Use /slice-and-dice to walk through co-editing a 4-section rollout document (Executive Summary, Opt-In Guidance, Default-On Checklist, and Non-Goals), proposing concrete text improvements section by section.
expected_chat_output: Echoes the Slice-and-Dice (SND) Progress Tracker at the top of the reply showing [SND 1/4] active ([-]) and remaining slices queued ([ ]).
Presents ONLY [SND 1/4] in chat without dumping the full content of slices 2-4.
Formats the candidate edit using Current Text (Before), Proposed Text (After), and What Changed (Added / Changed / Removed).
Yields in plain chat without invoking an interactive multiple-choice modal tool (ask_question / AskUserQuestion) during the active slice turn.
expected_repo_state: Stages the canonical Progress Tracker in the session artifact directory or /tmp/snd_plan_<slug>.md without creating untracked files in the repository worktree or injecting tracker lines into tracked repository files.
Uses lazy slice drafting in the working tracker (Progress Tracker + 1-line slice titles/notes) without pre-baking full Before/After diffs for queued slices 2-4.
Does not overwrite the target rollout document before the user confirms [SND 1/4].

evals.prompt: Run /snd on an 18-section cross-package architecture RFC where each section introduces a distinct ~60-second design decision.
expected_chat_output: Recognizes that natural ~60-second completeness-driven slicing yields N > 10 slices and halts before starting [SND 1/N].
Presents the grouped slice outline in chat so the user can see the full landscape.
Prompts the user with the 3 Pre-Flight Scope Gate options: (1) Focus on a high-priority sub-area first (Recommended), (2) Run a high-level Macro-SND (~6-8 slices), or (3) Proceed with all N slices.
expected_repo_state: No target repository files are modified before the user selects a scope option.

evals.prompt: Continue a /slice-and-dice document review at [SND 2/5] (Client Constructors), where inspecting lib/src/client.dart reveals that an earlier draft critique against the 3-parameter constructor was wrong because clientFactory grants lifecycle ownership while client disables internal closure.
expected_chat_output: Places an explicit Realization / Plan Update callout right below the Progress Tracker stating what primary-source check changed the agent's mind and how the plan or critique was updated.
Does not silently drop or swap the draft critique without explaining the realization upfront, and does not invent nitpicks if the section holds up in source.
If two distinct review comments remain for [SND 2/5], splits them into Comment 2A and Comment 2B with separate verbatim anchor quotes inside copy-pasteable text code fences.
expected_repo_state: Updates the persistent working artifact's Progress Tracker for [SND 2/5] while keeping base slice numbers 1..5 stable.
